Play a game to completion

Source: R/engine.R
dp_play.Rd

Steps the game until a power controls 18 supply centres or the turn cap is reached, recording every turn.

Usage

dp_play(
  game = dp_new_game(),
  bots = "greedy",
  max_years = 20,
  seed = NULL,
  verbose = FALSE,
  call = rlang::caller_env()
)

Arguments

game

A dp_game object to start from. Defaults to a new game.

bots

Bot assignment: a single bot name or a named character vector mapping power to bot.

max_years

Stop after this many game years. Default 20.

seed

Optional finite integer RNG seed. Restores the caller's random state afterwards, including on failure.

verbose

Report each year as it is played. Default FALSE.

call

Caller environment, for error reporting. Experts only.

Value

A dp_history object. The final state is in its last turn, and the outcome is on the history's outcome element.

See also

Other engine: dp_adjudicate(), dp_advance(), dp_build(), dp_result, dp_retreat(), dp_step(), is_dp_result()

Examples

h <- dp_play(bots = "hold", max_years = 2)
as_tibble(h)
#> # A tibble: 42 × 7
#>     turn season  year phase    power   centres units
#>    <int> <chr>  <int> <chr>    <chr>     <int> <int>
#>  1     1 Spring  1901 movement Russia        4     4
#>  2     1 Spring  1901 movement Austria       3     3
#>  3     1 Spring  1901 movement England       3     3
#>  4     1 Spring  1901 movement France        3     3
#>  5     1 Spring  1901 movement Germany       3     3
#>  6     1 Spring  1901 movement Italy         3     3
#>  7     1 Spring  1901 movement Turkey        3     3
#>  8     2 Fall    1901 movement Russia        4     4
#>  9     2 Fall    1901 movement Austria       3     3
#> 10     2 Fall    1901 movement England       3     3
